instruction:
Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_026_interference_assembly.step using SolidWorks. Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut). On this machine, run the SOLIDWORKS automation through `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe` when working on `cli_026_interference_assembly.step`.

Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file containing housing and sliding_pin as independent solids. The housing is a 60 x 60 x 35 mm block with a blind cylindrical bore along the X axis from X=-10 to the right face; the sliding_pin is an 18 mm diameter, 40 mm long cylinder on the same X axis. Move sliding_pin along its own X axis until there is no solid interference and the minimum axial clearance from the pin's left end to the blind bore bottom is 0.5 mm. Do not resize either part. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_026_clearance_fixed_out.step and write C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_026_interference_report.txt indicating zero interference and 0.5 mm clearance.
